question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Mighty
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mighty"** means possessing great and impressive power or strength, especially on account of size. (शक्तिशाली)

 
 
• **Example: **The** mighty** lion roared across the savannah, asserting its dominance.
 
 
 
• **"Weak"** refers to lacking physical strength and energy. (कमजोर)
 
 
• **Example: **After being sick for a week, he felt too** weak** to get out of bed.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Mighty'** is **'Weak'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Forcible** (बलपूर्वक): Done by force.

 
 
• **Example:** The police made a** forcible **entry into the building.
 
 
 
• **Forceful** (प्रभावशाली): Strong and assertive; vigorous and powerful.
 
 
• **Example: **Her speech was** forceful **and left a lasting impression on the audience.
 
 
 
• **Haughty** (घमंडी): Arrogantly superior and disdainful.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a** haughty** look to the servants as she walked by.
